count_unit: Distinct games with admitted playable soundtrack rooms, not total tracks or research candidates.
editorial_direction: Prioritize modern games with available official soundtracks.
No arbitrary three-track cap for iconic or complete-album requests.
Use original official recordings and accurate recording artists/composers. State remaster/platform/DLC versions instead of attributing later music to an earlier release.
Where licensed songs define the game, curate only those licensed recordings rather than adding less representative original score cues.
